title: §.XIII: Instrument words vindicated vs pedantic critics — gründliche Vorstellung; Arminianismum p.302
pass_a_gloss: These words, against truly pedantic Critics, the most recent Author of der gründliche Vorstellung / welche das einige wahre Mittel zur Vereinigung der beyden Evangelischen Religionen in Deutschland sey / has excellently vindicated at pag. 11. 9.8. — cited and praised by us elsewhere, namely in our Ingenua in Arminianismus Inquisitio, pag. 302.
pass_b_english: Against truly pedantic critics, the newest author of the Gründliche Vorstellung (Which Is the One True Means for Uniting the Two Evangelical Religions in Germany) has finely defended these words at pp. 11 and 98.
We cited and praised that author elsewhere — namely in our Ingenua in Arminianismus Inquisitio, p. 302.
source_text: Verba haec, contra verè pedanticos Criticos, egregiè vindicavit nuperrimus Auctor der gründliche Vorstellung/ welche das einige wahre Mittel zur Vereinigung der beyden Evangelischen Religionen in Deutschland sey/ pag. 11. 9.8. nobis alibi, in ingenua scilicet in Arminianismus Inquisitione nostra, pag. 302. citatus laudatusque.

choices.why: OCR gap reads as 11 and 98, not 9.8 decimal
Strimesius sister work; page cross-ref only
